sourceMiniAdventureTr: Çocuklar trende yiyecek ister ve aile vagondaki satıcıdan alışveriş yapar.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Zuò hǎo le, wǒ men chī zǎo fàn ba.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Hái zi men dōu è le.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ yào yí gè miàn bāo.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ yě yào! nà ge dà de!

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo de, yào jǐ gè miàn bāo?

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān kàn kàn, yǒu shén me miàn bāo?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè ge yuán de duō shǎo qián?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Kàn qǐ lái hěn hǎo chī.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Ā yí, zhè ge hái shì rè de ma?

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Shì rè de, yí gè wǔ yuán.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Nà wǒ men yào sì gè.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zài yào liǎng bēi chá.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shuǐ, bù yòng mǎi.
dialogues.tr: Benim suyum var, almamıza gerek yok.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ de shuǐ yě zài bāo lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Sì gè miàn bāo, liǎng bēi chá, duì ma?
dialogues.tr: Dört ekmek, iki fincan çay, doğru mu?

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Duì, chá gěi wǒ men liǎng gè.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Hái zi hē zì jǐ de shuǐ jiù hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, xiān bié pèng bēi zi.
dialogues.actionTr: Kardeşinin sıcak fincana uzanan elini durdurur.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bāng mā ma ná.
dialogues.actionTr: Annesine yardım etmek için elini uzatır.

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Chá hěn rè, wǒ lái fàng ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Yī bēi chá duō shǎo qián?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Miàn bāo shì wǔ yuán, chá ne?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Sì gè miàn bāo jiù shì èr shí yuán.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 还有爸爸妈妈的两杯茶。
dialogues.pinyin: Hái yǒu bà ba mā ma de liǎng bēi chá.
dialogues.tr: Bir de anne babamın iki fincan çayı var.

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.zh: 茶一杯八元，一共三十六元。
dialogues.pinyin: Chá yī bēi bā yuán, yī gòng sān shí liù yuán.
dialogues.tr: Çayın bir fincanı sekiz yuan, toplam otuz altı yuan.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ lái fù qián.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Qián zài nǐ de xiǎo bāo lǐ ba?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Bà ba, wǒ bāng nǐ ná bāo.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 我还以为你又找不到了。
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ yòu zhǎo bú dào le.

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Màn màn zhǎo, bù zháo jí.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Zhǎo dào le, qián kě méi yǒu diū.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Sān shí liù yuán, shǔ hǎo le ma?
dialogues.tr: Otuz altı yuan, doğru saydın mı?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Èr shí, jiā shí, zài jiā wǔ hé yī.
dialogues.tr: Yirmi, bir on daha, sonra beş ve bir.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ yě shǔ duì le!

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Zhèng hǎo, xiè xiè nín.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 也谢谢您，东西放这里吧。
dialogues.pinyin: Yě xiè xiè nín, dōng xi fàng zhè lǐ ba.
dialogues.tr: Biz de teşekkür ederiz, yiyecekleri buraya koyun.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhuō shàng xiān liú yì diǎn dì fāng.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ de shuǐ fàng zài zhè biān.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Nà wǒ bāng nǐ ná miàn bāo.

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Ná zhè ge ba, xiǎo xīn yì diǎn.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, xiān gěi mā ma yí gè.
dialogues.tr: Lele, önce annene bir tane ver.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiè xiè, zài gěi jiě jie yí gè.
dialogues.tr: Teşekkürler, bir tane de ablana ver.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ ná zhè ge xiǎo yì diǎn de.
dialogues.tr: Ben şu biraz daha küçük olanı alayım.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Dà de gěi bà ba, kě yǐ ma?

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Kě yǐ, nǐ men zì jǐ fēn ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 爸爸不用最大的，你吃吧。
dialogues.pinyin: Bà ba bù yòng zuì dà de, nǐ chī ba.
dialogues.tr: Babana en büyüğü lazım değil, sen ye.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Sì gè dōu hěn hǎo chī.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 你不是刚才还要大的吗？
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì gāng cái hái yào dà de ma?
dialogues.tr: Az önce büyük olanı istememiş miydin?

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Kě shì bà ba yě è le ya.

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn huì zhào gù bà ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Nà wǒ men yī rén yí gè, gòu le.
dialogues.tr: Öyleyse herkes bir tane alsın, yeter.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 大家都有，不用让来让去。
dialogues.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu yǒu, bù yòng ràng lái ràng qù.
dialogues.tr: Herkesinki var, birbirinize vermenize gerek yok.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo le, wǒ xiān chī yī kǒu.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Èn, zhēn de hǎo chī!

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Màn màn chī, bié tài kuài.
dialogues.tr: Yavaş yavaş yiyin, çok hızlı yemeyin.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Chá yě fàng hǎo le, xiè xiè.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ zhè bēi hái shì hěn rè.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 妈妈，那你等一会儿再喝。
dialogues.pinyin: Mā ma, nà nǐ děng yī huì er zài hē.
dialogues.actionTr: Annesine dönüp sakin bir sesle konuşur.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ hē shuǐ, shuǐ bù rè.
dialogues.tr: Ben su içiyorum, su sıcak değil.

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Duì, rè chá xiān fàng zhe.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Jīn tiān zǎo shàng zhēn máng.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiàn zài kě yǐ hǎo hǎo chī fàn le.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 刚才找票的时候，我也饿了。
dialogues.pinyin: Gāng cái zhǎo piào de shí hòu, wǒ yě è le.
dialogues.tr: Az önce bileti ararken ben de acıkmıştım.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ nà shí hòu zhǐ xiǎng zhe piào ne.
dialogues.tr: Ben o sırada sadece bileti düşünüyordum.

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ men shì qù lǚ xíng ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ men yào bān dào xīn de chéng shì.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 今天这顿早饭真不一样。
dialogues.pinyin: Jīn tiān zhè dùn zǎo fàn zhēn bù yí yàng.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Hái shì zài huǒ chē shàng chī de.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 新家也有这么好的面包吗？
dialogues.pinyin: Xīn jiā yě yǒu zhè me hǎo de miàn bāo ma?
dialogues.tr: Yeni evimizde de böyle güzel ekmek olacak mı?

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.zh: 到了以后，可以去店里看看。
dialogues.pinyin: Dào le yǐ hòu, kě yǐ qù diàn lǐ kàn kàn.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Bà ba huì gěi nǐ men mǎi de.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 先把今天的早饭吃好吧。
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān bǎ jīn tiān de zǎo fàn chī hǎo ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 乐乐，你嘴边有一点面包。
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, nǐ zuǐ biān yǒu yì diǎn miàn bāo.
dialogues.tr: Lele, ağzının kenarında biraz ekmek var.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Zài nǎr? zhè lǐ ma?

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Zhèr yǒu zhǐ, gěi nǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Xiè xiè, lè le ná hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Cā yī xià, jiù gān jìng le.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo le, xiàn zài méi yǒu le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Jiě jie bāng wǒ kàn, wǒ kàn bú jiàn.

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Jiě jie hěn xì xīn ya.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Yǔ tóng, yě hē diǎn shuǐ.
dialogues.tr: Yutong, sen de biraz su iç.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zài huǒ chē shàng bié zhǐ chī miàn bāo.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ hē le, shuǐ jiù zài zhè lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 爸爸，外面的树跑得好快！
dialogues.pinyin: Bà ba, wài miàn de shù pǎo dé hǎo kuài!
dialogues.tr: Baba, dışarıdaki ağaçlar çok hızlı koşuyor!

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Shì huǒ chē zài zǒu ne.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Shù méi pǎo, wǒ men zài wǎng qián zǒu.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 乐乐，你看窗外看得真认真。
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, nǐ kàn chuāng wài kàn dé zhēn rèn zhēn.
dialogues.tr: Lele, camın dışını ne dikkatli izliyorsun.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Tā dōu wàng le shǒu lǐ de miàn bāo.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: A, wǒ hái yǒu bàn gè!

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.zh: 吃不完的话，可以装起来。
dialogues.pinyin: Chī bù wán de huà, kě yǐ zhuāng qǐ lái.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān bù yòng zhuāng, ràng tā màn màn chī.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ men hái yǒu shí jiān.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 吃完了，再看外面也来得及。
dialogues.pinyin: Chī wán le, zài kàn wài miàn yě lái de jí.
dialogues.tr: Yemeğin bitince dışarıya bakmak için de zaman olacak.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ hái xiǎng ná xiǎo chē chū lái.
dialogues.tr: Bir de oyuncak arabamı çıkarmak istiyorum.

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Nà xiān chī fàn, zài wán ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Xiǎo chē gāng cái fàng jìn bāo lǐ le.
dialogues.tr: Oyuncak arabanı az önce çantana koymuştun.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Bié bǎ zhuō shàng de shuǐ pèng dǎo le.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Děng chī wán, wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo, xiè xiè ā yí de miàn bāo!

dialogues.speaker: 售货员
dialogues.pinyin: Bú kè qì, nǐ men màn màn chī.
